title: Pentax hotplug leaks allocations and a USB reference when registry is full
description:
The plug callback allocates device/private data and acquires a libusb reference before searching the ten-slot registry, then loses their ownership if no slot exists. Reserve a slot before allocation or clean up all acquired resources on the full-registry path; fake repeated over-capacity hotplug should retain allocations/reference counts. Existing bulb timing and PTP decoder records stay separate. Fixed and reverified by the linked repair task; source and runtime limits remain recorded there.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261101215425-fa40-complete-full-repository-audit-016.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
